description: StorageHealthCondition represents a health condition reported by a CSI driver for its storage backend on a node.

accessMode.description: accessMode is the access mode affected. Nil means all access modes are affected.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is when this condition first appeared at its current state. lastTransitionTime remains unchanged when only the message changes.

message.description: message is a human-readable description. Maximum permitted length of a message is 1024 bytes.

reason.description: reason is a brief CamelCase machine-parseable reason. Maximum permitted length of a reason is 256 bytes.

status.description:
status is the health status category. Possible values are: - "StorageHealthUnknown": the driver reported an unknown health status, or a status Kubernetes does not recognize; the backend must not be considered healthy. - "StorageUnreachable": the storage backend is unreachable. - "StorageDegraded": the storage backend is functioning with reduced capability. - "StorageHealthy": the storage backend is healthy as seen from this node.

Additional values may be introduced as the CSI specification evolves. Writers that do not recognize a status may classify it as StorageHealthUnknown. Readers that do not recognize a status must use it only for health reporting and observability.

volumeMode.description: volumeMode is the volume mode affected. Nil means both are affected.
